question: The Mahanadi river rises in the highlands of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **The Mahanadi River rises in the highlands of Chhattisgarh, which is located in central India.**
